root.label: Roger Rogoff sworn in as Western Washington U.S. attorney

events.label: Roger Rogoff files lawsuit against Trump and DOJ

slots.name: lawsuit filing date
slots.sentence: Later in July, Rogoff filed a lawsuit in federal court against President Donald Trump, Acting Attorney General Todd Blanche and the U.S. Department of Justice.

events.label: Roger Rogoff sworn in as Western Washington U.S. attorney

slots.name: appointment date
slots.sentence: On July 15, Rogoff was sworn in to be the U.S. attorney for the Western District of Washington state, taking over from Trump-appointee First Assistant U.S. Attorney Charles Neil Floyd.

events.label: Trump fires Roger Rogoff as Western Washington U.S. attorney

slots.name: employment status
slots.sentence: and he was fired by President Trump through an email roughly an hour later.

events.label: Trump nominates Pete Serrano as Western Washington U.S. attorney

slots.name: nomination date
slots.sentence: In September, Trump nominated Pete Serrano to the role of U.S. Attorney for Western Washington in an attempt to get around Rogoff's appointment.
